product.description: Monoprice™Low Profile Tilt TV Wall MountFits TVs 40 in to 90 in, Max Weight 165 lbs. VESA Patterns up to 600×400The Monoprice™ Low Profile Tilt TV Wall Mount is designed to accommodate televisions with a VESA® pattern ranging from 150×100 to 600×400. It's an excellent choice for displays spanning 40" up to 90" in size. Crafted from high-strength, cold-formed steel, this wall mount ensures safe and reliable support for weights of up to 165 lbs.Monoprice TV mounts undergo rigorous lab testing, doubling their rated weight capacity. In this case, the mount can handle over 300 lbs without damage. Rest assured that your TV is securely mounted.The Low Profile Tilt TV Wall Mount includes all the essential mounting hardware. Whether installing on brick, concrete, or wood stud walls, you won't need to make unnecessary trips to the local hardware store.Notable features of this wall mount include a tool-free adjustable tilt function. Able to tilt downward up to 8 degrees, you can effortlessly fine-tune your TV viewing angle. Should you need to reposition the TV or access cables at the back, the spring-tensioned locking lugs come equipped with quick-release pull tabs. These allow you to tilt the TV up and out of the way or simply remove it when necessary.Fits VESA® patterns from 150×100 to 600×400Designed for 40" ∼ 90" displaysSupports up to 165 lbsTool-free adjustable tilt from +0° ∼ -8°The back of the TV is just 1.5" from the wallSpring-tensioned locking lugs with quick-release pull tabs for simple TV removalMounting hardware includes mounting template and bubble levelMounts to brick, concrete, or wood stud wallsCold-formed, high-strength steel construction  EXTRA LARGE SIZE AND WEIGHT CAPACITYThe Monoprice™ Low Profile Tilt TV Wall Mount is compatible with VESA patterns up to 600×400, and supports a maximum weight capacity of 165 lbs, making it perfect for TVs up to 90" in size. Like all Monoprice TV mounts, the Heavy-Duty Tilt TV Wall Mount has undergone rigorous lab testing, holding double its rated weight at over 300 lbs without damage to the mount. EFFORTLESS VIEWING ANGLE ADJUSTMENTThe Tilt TV wall mount offers exceptional flexibility when it comes to adjusting your TV's angle. With a tilt range of up to 8°, plus toolless adjustment, you can easily change the viewing angle to match your seating position, or quickly reduce glare from nearby windows. EASY ACCESS DESIGNThe low-profile tilting design positions the TV a mere 1.5" from the wall. The mount features spring-tensioned locking lugs with quick-release pull tabs for effortless TV adjustments. Whether you need to reposition the TV or access cables at the back, a simple tug on the pull tabs enables you to tilt the TV upward and out of the way, or even remove it entirely if needed. PACKAGE CONTENTS• TV Mount • Mounting Hardware • User Manual   SAFETY YOU CAN TRUSTOn average, Monoprice™ sells a new wall mount every minute of every day!
